$description: Spacing values that sit off the 4px base and are kept anyway, because the component reproduces supplied artwork or a measured layout exactly. Every entry names the file, the values and the reason. scripts/lint-tokens.mjs fails if a listed value is no longer present, so a cleanup cannot leave a stale exception behind.

exceptions.reason: Caption gap and credential row gap measured from the supplied partnership layout. The co-brand set is delivered artwork and its spacing is part of what was approved.
The version caption sets a 2px gap between the label and the title, which reads as a single block rather than two stacked lines. On the 4px scale the pair separates.
